{{Top}}
'''Haillu''' were the term for earlobes by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] people. They were used for displaying emotion among others of their kind. Additionally, the [[Otolla/Legends|Otolla]] subspecies had larger haillu, while individuals belonging to the [[Ankura/Legends|Ankura]] subspecies traditionally possessed smaller haillu.

Some [[Gender/Legends|female]] Gungans, such as [[Peppi Bow/Legends|Peppi Bow]], tied their haillus together, in a similar fashion to the ponytail of individuals with [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="BSV">{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}</ref><ref name="CotF">{{TCW|Children of the Force}}</ref>
